answers.segment:3: {"name":"Slow-Paying Smaller Accounts","who":"51 mostly single-site customers (38 of 51) with about 3 sites each who pay an average of 50.04 days late versus 8.78 for all customers, and who spend $32,241.10 a year versus $48,115.62 overall, with job mix, quote approval (0.71) and decision time (8.65 days) near average.","treat":["Tighten payment terms for this segment: require deposits or card on file, send earlier invoice reminders, and follow up on accounts running 50 days late.","Offer a small early-pay discount or autopay option to bring the 50.04-day average lateness closer to the 8.78-day company average.","Keep the service relationship going with routine check-ins, since they are active (38.31 days since last job) and approve 0.71 of quotes, and pitch agreements only once payment is reliable, as only 0.40 of their sites are under agreement."]}

answers.segment:6: {"name":"Small Loyal Agreement Sites","who":"Mostly single-site customers (179 of 192) averaging 1.62 sites and 8.45 years with us, with 81% of sites under agreement, spending $7,832 a year over 8.11 jobs per site, with a lower repair share (0.54 vs 0.78) and faster quote decisions (3.54 days vs 8.66).","treat":["Keep agreements renewed and on schedule, since 81% of their sites are covered (vs 43% overall) and they've been customers for 8.45 years.","Send quotes promptly and follow up within a few days, since they decide in 3.54 days but approve only 40% of quotes (vs 68% overall); review pricing and scope on declined quotes.","Offer preventive maintenance add-ons to build on their lower repair share of 0.54, and reach out to those past the 34.68-day average since their last job."]}
